ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read the inequalities from the problem conditions: x≤3, x+y≥2, y≤x. The objective expression is x+2y, in which the coefficients of both x and y are positive, so to make x+2y maximum, x and y should be made to take larger values as much as possible. From x≤3, it can be known that the maximum of x does not exceed 3; and because y≤x and x≤3, y≤3. Therefore x+2y≤3+2×3=9. Check whether equality can be attained: take x=3, y=3, then x≤3, x+y=6≥2, y=x are satisfied, so the maximum value can reach 9.

method.method_draft: 从题目条件读取不等式：x≤3、x+y≥2、y≤x。因为目标式 x+2y 中 x 和 y 的系数都为正，应尽量让 x、y 大。由 x≤3 得 x 最大不超过 3；由 y≤x 且 x≤3 得 y≤3。因此 x+2y≤3+2×3=9。再检查等号能否取到：取 x=3, y=3，则满足 x≤3、x+y=6≥2、y=x，所以最大值为 9。
